behavior_change_rationale.4: Add-only growth is a diagnostic, not a mandatory deletion quota.
behavior_change_rationale.5: Independent review is capability-based rather than model-family-based. The prompt now asks the agent to decide and, if the review is incomplete, obtain it, matching the expected_output and expectations, which already describe performing the review rather than only judging it.
behavior_change_rationale.7: Reviewer independence is not inferred from model count or vendor. Expectation index 3 ('Turns any finding into a concrete action') stays in the case as a conditional expectation: this prompt only asks the agent to decide how to satisfy the independent-review requirement, so a run may never surface a finding to act on. It is intentionally excluded from critical_expectations and may legitimately grade applicable:false (N/A) rather than fail.
behavior_change_rationale.8: Generated artifacts and bounded compatibility migrations may justify temporary duplication.

clarification_rationale._critical_expectations: Finding-action, throwaway, and no-independent-review branches are conditional. They remain rubric-visible but are excluded from paired critical indexes so N/A cannot masquerade as a regression.
